acceptance: has_plans is true only when the companion contains at least one captured plan.
A pipeline test covers an errors-only companion.
The viewer's errors-only message remains reachable via a separate flag or the errors field if the product wants it.
context: From benchbox-site PR #124. Decide in the PR whether errors-only runs should still expose a link; default: no 'View plans' for them.
description: _project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/transformer.py (around line 1765) sets has_plans for any .plans.json, including one that holds only capture errors (for example Pandas). The Explorer then offers 'View plans' for a run with no plans; the viewer now says capture failed, but the flag is misleading.
